notes.title: Engine Change coming soon
notes.content:
[b]Upgrade to Unreal Engine 5[/b]

The whole game will be rebuild from scratch in Unreal Engine 5 to use this cutting edge technology.

[u]Improved: [/u]

[list]
[*] Lights
[*] Sounds
[*] Music
[*] Textures
[*] Draw instance
[*] Atmosphere
[*] Footsteps
[*] Detailed Map
[*] Lumen
[*] Nanite for better geometry
[/list]

There will be Team Death match mode , a Zombie mode, and a weapon showcase section.

The whole gameplay mechanics will be the similar , but instead of the normal camera, you playing through a fisheye lens body cam, with camera effects and better bobbing.

It will be optimized very well, but need to keep that in mind that because of the UE5 ,the system requirements will be a bit higher, as soon as i tested multiple computers, i will update the system requirements section to.

[u][b]Important, as soon as the engine change has been done, you won't be able to play this current UE4 map![/b][/u]
